scope: All273x65536 native stellar power samples. Header/source tutorial inspected; powers not yet inspected.
gain_normalization: Divide each time row by its full-band median; separately report raw row medians.

spectral.statistic: Median over time of row-normalized powers; divide by rolling median baseline,minus1; subtract rolling residual median,divide by1.4826 rolling median absolute local residual
spectral.edge_basis: Three composed257-channel local operators require384 native channels each side for fully supported score

temporal.statistic: Per-channel deviation from time median after row gain removal,divided by1.4826 temporal MAD
temporal.catalogue: Every connected component; top20 only in inline summary,all rows inCSV

context_basis: Official tutorial identifies HI near1420MHz and instrumental artifacts; predefined descriptive window,not independent attribution.
limitations: One author-deposited historical stellar scan,no OFF comparison; features are not extraterrestrial candidates.
2861Hz bins do not resolve usual narrowband Doppler drift; no fine-rate search or sensitivity inJy.
Robust contrast scores are not calibrated sigma,SNR,p-values or global false-alarm probability.
Local bandpass flattening and time-row gain removal alter broad spectral/temporal structures.
OriginalBA archive coverage remains unchanged; this is separate coarse-resolution stellar analysis.
No threshold tuning after inspecting powers; complete masks/catalogues preserved.
input_quality: Finite nonnegative native powers; positive finite row medians and entire rolling spectral baseline; nonfinite normalized power or supported scores stops analysis.
